evidence: Only known beach Pantai Olo (Bagan Deli, Medan Belawan) is a concrete-edged sea-connected pool where visitors swim; no natural sand beach found, Belawan coast is mangrove/abrasion zone - https://www.inews.id/regional/sumut/pantai-di-sumut

Akkarena beach (Tanjung Bunga, Tamalate, Kota Makassar): visitors can swim in calm waves; sand reportedly dark/grey - https://www.detik.com/sulsel/berita/d-7711675/8-tempat-liburan-akhir-tahun-2024-di-makassar-yang-seru-buat-quality-time/amp

Kenjeran shore is brown-black mud not sand, water murky; swimming now considered harmful (skin disease) - https://mojok.co/liputan/ragam/laser-air-mancur-jadi-cara-lain-nikmati-pantai-kenjeran-surabaya/amp/
Pantai Marina (Kota Semarang): calm waves, visitors can swim and play in the sand; sand quality described inconsistently - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/pantai-marina
Air Manis: wide gently sloping beach with brownish-white sand, waves support swimming - https://ejurnal.bunghatta.ac.id/index.php/JFEK/article/view/19117/15794

Siladen island (Bunaken Kepulauan, Kota Manado): white sand, relatively safe for children to swim; Malalayang (black sand) also used for swimming - https://www.kompas.tv/article/403114/keindahan-pantai-pasir-putih-terumbu-karang-di-pulau-siladen
Sindhu Beach Sanur: calm shallow water ideal for swimming especially for children; reef-protected sand beach - https://ebooks.denpasartourism.com/en/pantai-sindu/
Nongsa Beach: white sand, waves safe for children to swim - https://swiss-belhotel.com/en-gb/swiss-belinn-baloi-batam/experiences/nongsa-beach

Tanjung Pasir (Teluknaga, Kab. Tangerang): visitors swim, sunbathe and play in sand; caveat: litter and erosion reported - https://www.popmama.com/life/health/wisata-alam-tangerang-ada-apa-saja-00-sm58d-gjbsl3

Study of Teluk Betung Timur beaches (Duta Wisata, Tirtayasa, Puri Gading): all rated suitable for swimming tourism, calm currents - https://ejournal-balitbang.kkp.go.id/index.php/marlin/article/view/9016

Lasiana (Kelapa Lima, Kota Kupang): white sand, small-to-moderate waves, popular beach; caveat: litter washed in, explicit swimming mention thin - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/2025/01/22/3-pantai-cantik-di-kota-kupang-wajib-dikunjungi

Ulee Lheue: visitors can swim, jet ski, banana boat; calm waves behind breakwater; sand now black since 2004 tsunami; caveat: children swept by waves incident - https://www.cimbniaga.co.id/id/inspirasi/gayahidup/wisata-banda-aceh

Muara Bendera (Desa Pantai Bahagia, Muara Gembong): visitors can swim and play in the (brown) sand; caveat: coast largely mudflat/mangrove with severe abrasion - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/indonesiana/wisata/pantai-di-bekasi
UNVERIFIED: Muara Indah (Pantai Labu) has white soft clean sand and fairly clear water but no source found on swimming - https://digilib.unimed.ac.id/25068/6/4.%20NIM.%203123331016_ABSTRAK.pdf

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Baro (Gebang) has soft sand but sources mention only relaxing/fishing/boats, not swimming; Kab. Cirebon coast mostly mud - https://www.detik.com/jabar/wisata/d-8166539/5-alasan-pantai-baro-jadi-destinasi-seru-di-cirebon

Talise (Teluk Palu): residents come at weekends to swim and bathe in the morning; white sand pre-2018; caveat: post-tsunami shoreline change and a crocodile attack reported - https://www.djkn.kemenkeu.go.id/kpknl-palu/baca-artikel/13248/Daya-Tarik-Pantai-Talise-dan-Kampung-Nelayan-di-Palu-Ramai-Dikunjungi-Warga-Lokal.html

Mapak Indah (Sekarbela, Kota Mataram): black sand beach with relatively safe waves; BPBD separately warns visitors bathing in sea at Loang Baloq/Ampenan - https://journal.ummat.ac.id/index.php/geography/article/view/1432

Nambo (Abeli, Kota Kendari): 300 m sand (white-brownish), calm clear water suitable for swimming, safe for children; caveat: some pollution reported - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/tempat-wisata-kendari

Police asked visitors at Parangtritis, Samas, Goa Cemara, Kuwaru and Baru beaches not to swim; swimming in sea prohibited due to trenches and strong undercurrent - https://koran-jakarta.com/2023-12-13/cegah-warga-terseret-ombak-wisatawan-pantai-selatan-bantul-diingatkan-tidak-mandi-di-laut

Papuma (Pasir Putih Malikan): white sand, relatively calm waves; swimming and snorkeling listed; caveat: sources disagree on wave size - https://www.detik.com/jatim/wisata/d-8279800/menikmati-keindahan-pantai-papuma-jember-saat-liburan-akhir-tahun
